_source: Dolmenwood Player's Book, Mossling Knacks (p112-113). d6 table order.

knacks.name: Bird Friend
knacks.description: The mossling has learned the secret languages of forest birds and earned their trust.

abilities.name: Bird speech
abilities.description: Converse with birds and understand their (typically simplistic) replies.

abilities.name: Bird companion
abilities.description: Charm a bird companion of Level 1 or less (Save Versus Spell to resist). It remains until dismissed. Only one at a time.

abilities.name: Twittering message
abilities.description: Once per day, forest birds relay a message of up to 10 words at 12 miles per hour to a specified person or location.

abilities.name: Summon flock
abilities.description: Once per day, call a flock of woodland birds (Level 3, AC 13, HP 3d8, pecks +2 1d6, Fly 40) that serves for 1d4 Turns.

knacks.name: Lock Singer
knacks.description: The mossling studies closely-guarded songs with the power to charm locks.

abilities.name: Open simple locks
abilities.description: Per Turn of singing to a simple, mundane lock: 2-in-6 chance it is coaxed open.

abilities.name: Locate key
abilities.description: A whispered cant persuades a lock to reveal the location of its key (or the closest, if several exist).

abilities.name: Snap shut
abilities.description: Simple, mundane locks within 30' instantly snap shut after a single Round of song.

abilities.name: Open any lock
abilities.description: Any lock opens with a 2-in-6 chance per Turn of singing. Magically sealed locks cooperate, but 1-in-6 chance the magic backfires, sealing the mossling's mouth shut for 1d4 days.

knacks.name: Root Friend
knacks.description: Dwelling in subterranean burrows, the mossling has a keen affinity with the roots of forest plants.

abilities.name: Root question
abilities.description: Once per day, ask a root one question about its surroundings; it answers truthfully with 1d6 words.

abilities.name: Summon roots
abilities.description: Once per day, summon edible roots to the surface: 1d4 fresh rations.

abilities.name: Root respite
abilities.description: Once per day, shelter unnoticed in the roots of a tree or large plant for up to an hour.

abilities.name: Summon root thing
abilities.description: Once per day, summon a monstrous root vegetable (Level 3, AC 13, HP 3d8, 2 claws +2 1d4 + entangle). It arrives in 1d6 Rounds and obeys for 1d6 Turns.

knacks.name: Thread Whistling
knacks.description: A mysterious whistling technique grants sympathetic control over threads and strings within 30'.

abilities.name: Thread mastery
abilities.description: Whistling ties, unties, or unravels any textile thinner than rope: string, laces, garment fabric.

abilities.name: Animate threads
abilities.description: Command loose threads to move up to 5' per Round while whistling. They can drag small objects (up to 20 coins weight) but cannot attack.

abilities.name: Rope mastery
abilities.description: Ropes loosen or tighten at the mossling's command.

abilities.name: Animate rope
abilities.description: A rope animates to attack and entangle foes (Level 1, AC 13, HP 1d8, grab entangles; constrict 1d3/Round; Save Versus Hold to escape) while the mossling concentrates and whistles.

knacks.name: Wood Kenning
knacks.description: The mossling's fingers sense the subtle vibrations of tree and wood; 1 Turn of touch gleans knowledge.

abilities.name: Sense history
abilities.description: Learn the name of a wooden item's creator or of the last person to touch it.

abilities.name: Sense emotions
abilities.description: Discern the most recent strong emotion the wood absorbed from a sentient being.

abilities.name: See beyond
abilities.description: Gain a momentary image of what lies on the other side of a wooden barrier (a door or wall).

abilities.name: True name
abilities.description: Learn a tree's true name. Once per day, invoke a known tree to glimpse its surroundings; invoking a deceased tree's name provokes a vision of the vegetable afterlife.

knacks.name: Yeast Master
knacks.description: The mossling hears the chorus of the deep wood's yeasts and fungal spores, and counts them as companions.

abilities.name: Ferment
abilities.description: Touch ferments sweet liquids (one pint per Turn) into a frothy brew delicious to mosslings; 2-in-6 chance it is palatable to other folk.

abilities.name: Commune with yeast
abilities.description: Sip from a drink partly consumed by someone else to learn that person's name.

abilities.name: Yeasty belch
abilities.description: Once per day, emit a heady belch at an individual within 10'; target must Save Versus Blast or faint for 1d6 Rounds.

abilities.name: Yeast feast
abilities.description: Once per day, conjure a yeasty feast equivalent to 1d6 fresh rations.
